datasets.sql:
select distinct ic.id as idc,user,ic.rowid,ic.commit_date,ii.name as s_novu,(select name from ins_bnf_type where id=ic.bnf_type) as fayda_goturen,ics.dateofbirth as dogumgunu,trim(ics.surname||' '||ics.name||' '||ics.fathername) as custname2,
av.val_name as valyuta,ic.policy_num as polis,ic.close_prefix as close_prefix,trim(ics.surname||' '||ics.name||' '||ics.fathername) as custname,cust.name as custgroup,(select INSURED_OBJ from ins_commercialproperty  where cid=ic.id) sigorta_obyekti
,cust.id as custgroup_id,ia.surname||' '||ia.name||' '||ia.fathername as agent,ins_report.get_S_haqq(ic.id) as ammount,ins_report.get_s_mebleg(ic.id) as inssumm,(select CASE WHEN ic.type_id = 3 THEN em.cost WHEN ic.type_id = 44 THEN em.cost WHEN ic.type_id = 4 THEN mk.drivecost WHEN ic.type_id = 41 THEN mk.drivecost WHEN ic.type_id = 1 THEN mk.drivecost WHEN ic.type_id = 13 THEN mk.drivecost WHEN ic.type_id = 43 THEN mk.drivecost WHEN ic.type_id = 42 THEN mk.drivecost eND AS aaa from ins_contracts where id=ic.id) as Sig_Oby_deyeri,ic.tariff as tariff,
ic.filial, ic.franshiz as franshiz,trunc(ic.ins_date) as ins_date, ic.begin_date as begin_date,ic.end_date as end_date,ic.state as state,ic.insured as insured
,ic.type_id as type_id,ii.mainformguid as mainformguid, ii.changeguid as changeguid,ic.loanacc_id as loanacc_id, ic.curracc_id as curracc_id,ic.agent_id as agent_id,ic.kli_id as kli_id,
ii.suggestionguid as suggestionguid, ii.policyguid as policyguid, ii.mainformname AS tablename,im.id,im.INSUREDMARK as marka,im.INSUREDMODEL as model,(select case when payment_type=1 then 'Tam odenis' else 'Hisselerle odenis' end from ins_payment_plan_setting where cid=ic.id) as odenis_novu,em.locationobj as obyekt_adrees
,nvl((select abs(ostat) from tenostat where acc_id= ic.loanacc_id AND OSTAT<0),0) debitor,im.INSUREDSTATENUM as dovlet_n,ins_common.count_full_claim(ic.id) as c_full_claim,im.INSUREDCOLOR as rengi,im.INSUREDOUTPUTYEAR as buraxlis_ili,im.INSUREDENGINENUM as muherrik_n,im.UNDERFRAMENUM as sassi_n,
case when ics.mobilephone is not null then ics.mobilephone     when ics.mobilephone is null then (select phone from ins_draccesspeople where  cid in (ic.id)and phone is not null and name is not null and ins_date= (select min(ins_date) from ins_draccesspeople where cid in(ic.id)and phone is not null and name is not null))  end as mobilephone,ics.address as adress,im.INSUREDBANNUM as ban_n,im.color_id as reng,im.model_id as model_id,im.marka_id as marka_id
,ins_common.get_tekrarsigorta(ic.id) as tekrarsigortaci,sum(ins_reins.get_reins_haqq_one(ir.bardero_no,ir.type_id,ir.id)) as Tekrarsigorta_haqqi,nvl(ins_common.get_due_day(ic.id),0) as gecikme_gunleri,
(nvl(((ic.inssumm)*(select sum(reins_part)from ins_reinsurance  where cid=ic.id group by ic.id))/100,0)) as Tekrarsigorta_mebleq,ict.stage_tesdiq_dat as xitam_tarixi
,nvl((ictd.terminted_amount),0) as qaytarilmis_mebleq,decode (cust.cust_type,0,'Huquqi',1,'Fiziki') as Musteri_novu,(nvl(ictd.terminted_amount,0)*(nvl(sum(ir.reins_part),0)))/100 as qayta_meb_tek_siq_pay,ic.userinsert as user_adi,trim(translate(ics.surname||' '||ics.name||' '||ics.fathername, 'IiIiI?', '``````')) as name1,(select case when payment_type=1 then 'Tam odenis' else 'Hisselerle odenis' end from ins_payment_plan_setting where cid=ic.id) as odenis_novu  ,decode (cust.cust_type,0,(select inn from customers where id=cust.id),1,(select passpin from custinfo where idcust=cust.id)) as Voen_Pin
from ins_contracts ic,ins_insurances ii,avalute av,ins_customers ics,customers cust,ins_agents ia,ins_motorkasco im,
ins_contract_terminated ict,ins_contract_terminated_detal ictd,ins_reinsurance ir,ins_commercialproperty em,ins_motorkasco mk
where ic.type_id=ii.id and em.cid(+)=ic.id and mk.cid (+)= ic.id
and ic.valute_id=av.valute and  ic.kli_id=ics.id and  cust.id=ics.cust_id
and  ia.id(+)=ic.agent_id 
and  im.cid(+)=ic.id and ic.reins=0
and ict.cid(+)=ic.id  
and ictd.ter_id(+)=ict.id and ir.cid(+)=ic.id
and ic.ins_date=sbop.get_date


--bir muqavilede 2 tekrarsiqorta olduqu ucun gruplawdirmiwam (nvl(((ic.ammount)*(select sum(reins_part)from ins_reinsurance  where cid=ic.id group by ic.id))/100,0)) as Tekrarsigorta_haqqi kohne versiyasi Mail deyiwdirib

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.rowid, ic.ID , ic.kli_id, ic.loanacc_id, ic.curracc_id, 
                 ii.NAME, ii.mainformguid, ii.changeguid,ic.commitop_id,ic.commit_date,ic.cancelopid,ic.canceldate,
                 ii.suggestionguid, ii.policyguid, ii.mainformname AS tablename, ic.policy_num,
                 trunc(ic.ins_date) as ins_date, ins_report.get_S_haqq(ic.id) as ammount, ic.begin_date, ic.end_date, av.val_name,
                  ins_report.get_s_mebleg(ic.id) as inssumm, ic.tariff, ic.franshiz, ic.state, ic.type_id ,ic.close_prefix 
                 FROM ins_contracts ic, ins_insurances ii, avalute av,ins_contract_responsibility r,ins_contr_per_acc_motor p
                 WHERE ii.ID = ic.type_id and r.cid(+)=ic.id and p.cid(+)=ic.id
               
                 and ic.close_prefix=0
                 and ic.valute_id = av.valute(+)

datasets.name: ODSAccount
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   acc.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider, ownid, t.ostat, t.pok_ostat
FROM ACCOUNT  acc, tenostat t
where  t.acc_id = acc.id
and
 ownid = :ownid
and acc.close_dat is null
ORDER BY 
   id

select smart.ins_common.insbenef(a2.ownid) as sigortali ,
--cus.name||' '||cus.surname ||' '||cus.fathername as sigorta_olunan ,
(select name from ins_insurances where id=(select type_id from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid) and branch=(select filialid from sba_objinf where obj=(select user from dual)) ) as sigortaNovu,
a1.name  as debtname,
a1.acc_no as debthesab,
a2.name  as kreditname,
a2.acc_no  as kredithesab,
(select name||' '||surname  from ins_agents where id=(select agent_id from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid)) as agent_Adi,
(select inssumm from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid) as sigortam?bl?ği,
smart.ins_report.get_S_haqq(a2.ownid) as sigorta_haqq,
pr.ammount as öd?nilmis,
(select ins_date from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid)  as daxiletme,
(select begin_date from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid) as baslama ,
(select end_date from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid) as bitme,
smart.ins_common.inspolis(a2.ownid) as polis,
(select name from ins_bnf_type where id=(select bnf_type from ins_contracts where id=a2.ownid)) as FaydaGoturen,
(select name from filial where id=a2.filial)
 as filial
from provarch pr,account a1,account a2
where  pr.dat between :dat1 and :dat2
and a1.id=pr.debt and a2.id=pr.kredit 
and a2.bal_cn1 in (:balcnkr)
 and a1.bal_cn1 in (:balcndb)
